rationale: The workflow is a minimal reusable Gradle wrapper-validation job (checkout + gradle/actions/wrapper-validation) with no Gradle build, test run, matrix, schedule, or dependency fetch. The strongest measured evidence (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE experiment, ~20% elapsed savings) presupposes a ./gradlew build that repeatedly fetches dependencies; this workflow lacks one, so adding a ~/.gradle/caches step would be an unused, unrelated change that could add restore/save overhead with no benefit. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is only synthetic/estimated and carries an explicit unresolved required-check/branch-protection caveat for a reusable validation check, so it is not safely applicable here without a separate review. No other pattern fits the trigger/job shape. Coverage is preserved and unrelated changes are avoided by making no change.
